rec.name: PDP Fullscreen Image Slider with Floating Buy Box
rec.status: Built — delivered (code + install instructions provided; docs reviewed)

what.text: Replaces the default PDP gallery with a full-viewport, horizontally swipeable image/video slider (Swiper). On desktop (≥1000px) the slider fills the screen below the header and the buy box floats as a card over the images at the bottom-right (offset from right/bottom is configurable). The buy box shows the product title, price, variant selection, add-to-cart button and delivery/returns info. On mobile the buy box sits below the slider and the images remain swipeable. Navigation is via swipe, mouse drag, keyboard or prev/next arrows, with optional pagination dots. Reference: Marshall Major V PDP.

why.text: Immersive, edge-to-edge imagery builds emotional desire and perceived product quality, which is especially effective for lifestyle and premium products. Keeping the buy box permanently visible over the gallery means price, variant choice and CTA are always in view, so the shopper never has to scroll to find the purchase action. Peeking at the next slide on mobile and visible arrows encourage image exploration and reduce friction.

how.text: 1) In main-product.liquid, add the 'Fullscreen slider Settings' schema block (slides per view for desktop/tablet/mobile, next-slide peek %, video autoplay, pagination, arrows, autoplay with freeMode, duration, stop on interaction, buy box offsets from right/bottom). 2) Create the snippet pdp-fullscreen-image-slider.liquid, which loops product.media and renders image slides (lazy-loaded unless the selected media), video slides (custom play/pause overlay) and optional cross-sell image blocks. It initialises Swiper with loop and breakpoints at 740px and 1000px. 3) Load Swiper 11 CSS/JS from the jsDelivr CDN in theme.liquid. 4) In main-product.liquid, replace the default slider with {% render 'pdp-fullscreen-image-slider' %}. On ≥1000px the wrapper is absolutely positioned over a 100vh container, and .product__info is pushed to the bottom-right with configurable margins. On <1000px the buy box flows below the slider with 24px padding.

items: Next slide peek on mobile (0–9%, default 5)
Info box offset from right (0–200px, default 80)
Info box offset from bottom (0–200px, default 60)
Buy Box settings (existing theme): enable, sticky, border colour, background colour, border radius

dependencies.text: Swiper v11 (CSS + JS via CDN in theme.liquid). Theme must have main-product.liquid with a .product__info buy box and CSS variables --header-height / --announcement-bar-height. The snippet reuses the optional 'cro_crosssale_items' block and the 'ed_cro_cross_sale_in_product_image' snippet. Buy box content comes from the existing theme blocks, metafields or settings. The original ticket asked for 1–10 images, 16:9 or 4:5, and a 30–40% wide buy box; the delivered code uses all product.media instead. External video and 3D model slides are commented out and not supported.

items: Page speed / LCP impact (heavy full-screen images)

images.caption: Reference (Marshall): fullscreen lifestyle image with a floating buy box at bottom-right (title, rating, description, colour swatches, price, CTA, delivery and returns accordions) and prev/next arrows at the bottom.

Shopify theme customizer showing the 'Fullscreen slider Settings' group (slides per view, peek, video autoplay, pagination, arrows, autoplay, duration, info box offsets) and the built version with a floating buy box over a full-width product image.
